IBRAQ Irth Balm Collection – 3 × 6ml

Discover the IBRAQ Irth Collection, a refined set of three fragrance balms that tell a story inspired by the heritage and symbolism of the palm tree. Each balm represents a stage of a journey, from the seed to the fruit, celebrating deep roots, continuous growth, resilience, and generosity.

✨ Three distinctive fragrance balms in a compact format
✨ Inspired by the beauty and symbolism of the palm tree
✨ A meaningful fragrance journey celebrating heritage and nature
✨ Ideal for personal use or as an elegant gift

The Irth Journey:

  • Nawa Balm – 6ml: Inspired by the seed, symbolizing hope, growth, and new beginnings.
  • Jareed Balm – 6ml: Inspired by palm fronds, representing shade, serenity, and continuity.
  • Ethq Balm – 6ml: Inspired by the fruit-bearing cluster of the palm, symbolizing abundance, growth, and generosity.
